title: PricesPublishedV1
description: Market Data finished publishing a day's price file. Carries identifiers only — never prices, holdings or anything about a user — like every event (design doc §8.3).   Contracts are versioned by name and change only additively. A breaking change is a new PricesPublishedV2 published alongside this one until every consumer has moved. The message identity is pinned so renaming the C# type can never silently change what goes on the wire.
